title: MILUV: A Multi-UAV Indoor Localization dataset with UWB and Vision
version: Figshare Plus v1; devkit and clock model revisions pinned in the documents below

inputs: All three robot directories from all 16 three-robot experiment archives in the versioned 39-file deposit. Three complete UWB active, three passive and three mocap CSVs per experiment; also checked each timeshift.yaml. No single-robot runs, images, CIR waveforms, unprocessed bags or separate calibration experiment. 160 verified members, 988697938 unpacked bytes. Original archive-wide supplied MD5 values are recorded for retrieval; the full archives were not downloaded. HTTP range read central directories; validated byte Content-Range, deflated payload sizes, ZIP CRC32 and computed per-member SHA-256.

data_semantics.identity: One retained active transaction is addressed by from_id, to_id and all six original radio timestamps. One passive observation adds the listener ID and its three raw reception timestamps. Robot-specific exports are selected by whether its tag was an active endpoint, even in the passive file; the directory name is not necessarily the observer. Collapse identical selected fields within experiment; require a unique active identity, a unique passive identity, and at most one row per listener and matched transaction. Check copied ranges and copied active header timestamps after the join. These files contain successful/retained transactions only: publisher postprocessing removes active measurements with absolute pre-calibration bias >=4 m and drops passive observations without a matching active event. There is no total transmitted or listened-for denominator.
data_semantics.clocks: Program header times are seconds relative to a common experiment origin; publisher cleanup shifts both timestamp and timestamp_n. Paper describes Chrony/NTP synchronization of computers at the start of each experiment, explicitly retaining independent radio oscillators and no ground truth clock offsets. The six low-level radio times have nanosecond units on the initiating/responding clocks. Subtracting host headers measures differences between logging events, not propagation, sensor delivery, command adoption or closed-loop information age. Negative signs are retained.
data_semantics.active: The first message is sent by the initiator and received by the responder; messages two and three are sent by the responder and received by the initiator (paper Fig. 7). Use within-clock differences modulo the archived 32-bit period, then 0.5*c*(dt1-dt3/dt4*dt2), c=0.299702547 m/ns, following pyuwbcalib. Range errors use publisher gt_range (m), before/after stored correction. Each experiment/link is evaluated on the same retained rows. A group with many events is not many independent flights.
data_semantics.geometry: Independently reload motion-capture poses at the original active timestamp using component-wise linear interpolation of xyz and xyzw quaternion followed by normalization and rotation of the tag moment arm, plus matching fixed anchor coordinates. Compare only inside the position streams needed for each link; do not extrapolate. Location reference is derived from the same mocap system as publisher gt_range; close agreement checks field interpretation, not absolute accuracy.
data_semantics.passive: Descriptive differential range to the responder minus to the initiator. Use corrected per-listener local intervals L21=rx2-rx1, L32=rx3-rx2, responder B32=tx3-tx2, B21=tx2-rx1; all within-clock modulo the DW1000 period. Estimate c*(L21*B32/L32-B21) minus the recorded corrected active range. Compare with simultaneous mocap geometry at the active header, ignoring within-handshake motion. Not a calibrated TDoA solution or a correction for invalid records. Publish median, 95th absolute error and untrimmed RMSE including large anomalies. The static triangle bound |d(listener,responder)-d(listener,initiator)| <= d(initiator,responder) is checked with an additional 1 m descriptive tolerance; it flags physical inconsistency, not a proven failure mechanism. No geometry residual or header gap is deleted for being large.
data_semantics.selection_limits: The obstacle flight also records CIR and has a different acquisition rate. Non-randomized trajectories/conditions. Per-experiment comparisons do not isolate effects of obstructions or recording mode.

reproduction: Run python fetch_miluv_subset.py INPUT_DIR to fetch and verify members. Then python derive_miluv.py INPUT_DIR OUTPUT_DIR with pandas, NumPy, SciPy and PyYAML. If downloading complete archives instead, extract each to INPUT_DIR/ and obtain the three configuration files from the pinned URLs.
